facts.zh: 以 3D 地球和 2D 世界地图联动展示足球数据，打造更具沉浸感的探索体验。 基于 Next.js、TypeScript、Three.js 和 Mapbox GL 构建，用 Framer Motion 做落地页转场，用 Three.js 与 Mapbox GL 实现 3D 地球和 2D 地图的联动展示，结合天地图底图与 Mapbox 渲染，兼顾国内场景下的地图合规性与交互表现。
facts.en: A football explorer linking a 3D globe and 2D map. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Three.js, and Mapbox GL, with Framer Motion driving the landing-page transitions. It links a 3D globe and a 2D world map to present football data, combining Tianditu basemaps with Mapbox rendering to balance map compliance in mainland use cases with strong interaction quality.

facts.zh: 把美剧字幕做成交互式英语学习，兼顾口语、剧情和跟读。 ScriptMind 是一个基于美剧字幕的英语学习 Web 应用，支持按季导入、按集学习和场景化练习。产品前端基于 Next.js 与 TypeScript 构建，后端采用 Postgres、pgvector 和 AI 解析流程，把原始字幕整理成可用于口语训练、剧情理解和表达学习的结构化内容。
facts.en: TV subtitles turned into interactive speaking practice. ScriptMind is a subtitle-driven English learning web app built around season imports, episode-by-episode study, and scene-based practice. The frontend is built with Next.js and TypeScript, while the backend combines Postgres, pgvector, and an AI parsing pipeline to turn raw subtitles into structured material for speaking drills, story comprehension, and expression building.

en.stack: Next.js / TypeScript / Postgres / pgvector / AI Subtitle Parsing / Scene-Based Study
en.type: Subtitle Parsing / AI Learning / Speaking Practice

keywords: 一个面向 vibe coding 的原生 macOS 桌宠与专注成长系统。
A native macOS desktop pet and focus growth system built for vibe coding.

facts.zh: 一个面向 vibe coding 的原生 macOS 桌宠与专注成长系统。 BugPet 使用 Swift、AppKit 与 SpriteKit 构建，是一个原生 macOS 桌面宠物应用。它通过前台应用识别、状态判断与交互反馈，把 coding 时长转化为宠物成长、专注统计和轻量游戏化体验。项目重点放在原生桌面交互、行为反馈机制和可持续扩展的宠物系统设计上。
facts.en: A native macOS desktop pet and focus growth system built for vibe coding. BugPet is a native macOS desktop pet built with Swift, AppKit, and SpriteKit. It uses foreground app detection, state judgment, and interaction feedback to turn coding time into pet progression, focus stats, and lightweight gamified loops. The project centers on native desktop interaction, behavioral feedback, and a pet system designed for sustainable expansion.

en.stack: A native macOS desktop pet and focus growth system built for vibe coding.

zh.技术栈: 一个面向 vibe coding 的原生 macOS 桌宠与专注成长系统。
zh.类型: 原生 / 桌宠 / 效率

facts.zh: 暗黑 issue 切换式艺人宇宙，围绕音乐时间线与专辑档案展开。 YeVerse 是一个非官方音乐人物档案网站原型，用沉浸界面重组艺人时间线、唱片和文化资料。我负责视觉方向、信息架构、React 前端实现和交互动效。项目把 Hero、Timeline、Discography、Archive、About 拆成独立 issue，并重点实现 3D CD 专辑展示、点击翻面、专辑详情和中英切换。
facts.en: A dark issue-based artist universe for music timelines and album archives. YeVerse is an unofficial artist archive prototype that reorganizes music timelines, albums, and cultural material through an immersive interface. I handled visual direction, information architecture, React implementation, and interaction motion. Hero, Timeline, Discography, Archive, and About are separated into issue-style screens, with a 3D CD shelf, flip interaction, album details, and bilingual content as the core experience.

en.stack: React / TypeScript / Vite / Three.js / CSS Animation / i18n / Music Research
en.type: Frontend Design / Interaction Design / Visual Prototype

facts.zh: Targeting 2026（剑指美加墨）是一款以2026年世界杯为主题的像素足球经营游戏。我负责大部分策划与开发，包括选队、征召、阵型、后勤、实时比赛、临场决策和赛后复盘的完整流程，并设计了国家队、候选池、战术姿态、天气和点球等系统。通过模拟脚本验证数值策略和决策收益，避免硬编码式胜负。项目重点是将复杂系统、内容叙事、玩法反馈和工程落地整合为一个完整可玩的整体。
facts.en: Targeting 2026 is a pixel football management game themed around the 2026 World Cup. I handled most of the design and development, including the complete loop of team selection, call-ups, formations, logistics, live matches, in-game decisions, and post-match review, and designed systems for national teams, player pools, tactical stances, weather, and penalties. Simulation scripts validate the numbers behind every decision instead of hard-coded outcomes. The focus is combining complex systems, content narrative, gameplay feedback, and solid engineering into one playable whole.

en.stack: Game Design / Tuning Systems / Live Simulation / Web Frontend / Pixel Art
en.type: Game Design / Interactive System / Pixel Experience

zh.技术栈: 游戏策划 / 数值系统 / 实时模拟 / Web 前端 / 像素美术
zh.类型: 游戏策划 / 互动系统 / 像素体验

facts.zh: 多专科临床 AI Agent Demo，展示建议冲突与优先级排序。面向心衰、慢性肾病、糖尿病等多病共存场景的多 Agent 临床决策支持原型。心内科、肾内科、内分泌科 agents 生成结构化建议，再由确定性 TOPSIS 逻辑排序优先级。负责产品界面、A2A 后端接入、FHIR context 支持、结果解析、错误兜底、演示视频和提交材料。技术栈：React / Vite / FastAPI / Google ADK / A2A / FHIR / LiteLLM / DeepSeek / Cloud Run / Vercel。
facts.en: A clinical AI agent demo for specialist advice, conflicts, and ranked priorities. Multi-agent clinical decision support prototype for complex chronic cases such as heart failure, CKD, and diabetes. Cardiology, nephrology, and endocrinology agents generate structured recommendations, then deterministic TOPSIS scoring ranks priorities. Built product interface, A2A backend integration, FHIR context support, response parsing, fallback behavior, demo video, and submission materials. Stack: React / Vite / FastAPI / Google ADK / A2A / FHIR / LiteLLM / DeepSeek / Cloud Run / Vercel.

en.stack: React / Vite / FastAPI / Google ADK / A2A / FHIR / LiteLLM / DeepSeek / Cloud Run / Vercel
en.type: AI Application / Frontend Design / Healthcare Tool

zh.技术栈: React / Vite / FastAPI / Google ADK / A2A / FHIR / LiteLLM / DeepSeek / Cloud Run / Vercel
zh.类型: AI 应用 / 前端设计 / 医疗工具

facts.zh: AI 逐行标注英文歌词发音，把连读、弱读和重音可视化。面向非母语者学唱英文歌时的发音细节痛点。用户搜索或导入歌词后，Gemini AI 逐行分析连读、弱读、省音和重音，并由前端实时渲染。独立完成产品定义、UI/UX、React 前端、Supabase Edge Function、Prompt 调优和歌词解析器，并用 JSON 模式与 8 行分块策略提升稳定性和首屏速度。技术栈：React 19 / TypeScript / Vite / Tailwind CSS / shadcn-ui / Supabase Edge Functions / Gemini 2.5 Flash / Apple Music API。
facts.en: AI line-by-line lyric annotations for liaison, weak forms, and stress. Helps non-native speakers understand pronunciation details when singing English songs. After users search or import lyrics, Gemini AI analyzes liaison, weak forms, elision, and stress line by line, then frontend renders inline annotations. Handled product definition, UI/UX, React frontend, Supabase Edge Functions, prompt tuning, and custom lyrics parser, using JSON mode and 8-line chunking to improve stability and first-result speed. Stack: React 19 / TypeScript / Vite / Tailwind CSS / shadcn-ui / Supabase Edge Functions / Gemini 2.5 Flash / Apple Music API.

en.stack: React 19 / TypeScript / Vite / Tailwind CSS / shadcn-ui / Supabase Edge Functions / Gemini 2.5 Flash / Apple Music API

zh.技术栈: React 19 / TypeScript / Vite / Tailwind CSS / shadcn-ui / Supabase Edge Functions / Gemini 2.5 Flash / Apple Music API
zh.类型: 前端开发 / AI 应用 / 教育工具
